To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the implementation of ERP systems is a complex and challenging task.
the implementation of ERP systems in a multinational environment is complex and that there are a number of factors that influence the success of such an implementation.

the key success factors of multinational ERP implementation are: (1) business process reengineering; (2) customisation; (3) federalism; (4) supply chain features; (5) outsourcing; and (6) labour skills.

identifying factors that influence multinational ERP implementation.
the implementation of ERP systems in multinational companies.
the identification and classification of factors that affect multinational ERP implementations.

the implementation of ERP in multinational companies is complex, difficult and costly.
multinational ERP implementations are difficult, but not impossible.

the technical issues are of more concern in multinational ERP implementations than the more general ones.
multinational implementation of ERP is not just about the technology.

multinational ERP implementation is a complex task and that careful consideration of all the factors involved is needed.
